note: The weights are my own judgement, not fitted to data. Each score is the weighted mean of the p_<input> percentiles that exist for a player; missing inputs are skipped, not counted as zero. Raw uses 2025 rates, never counting stats, so the delta (Underlying minus Raw) isn't driven by playing time.

reliability.note: The 2026 tool's reliability score, rebuilt on 2023-25: recency = games (hitters) or innings (SP) per season, averaged with weight e^(lambda * i) from oldest (i = 0) to newest; proj = Marcel projected PA or IP; recency and proj are percentiles within the group (share strictly below, 0-100); age_rel = 50 through age 33, 40 at 34, then 5 less per year, floored at 0. Consistency has weight 0 and isn't computed.
